base_without_esme.note: Esme's chair and Mr Cat's stool left empty

looks: day or night (the inside has no rain look: rain days show the day base)

tv.note: the bar TV always shows a Brighton and Hove Albion game (blue-and-white stripes, white shorts) against a red side. Loop the frames in order (0, 1, 2) over the full base at 'at', about 220 ms a frame. Each frame is the screen's size and transparent where someone stands in front of it. With reduced motion, show nothing: the base already shows frame 0.

foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame; draw at left = x - w//2, top = y - h + 1
draw_order: sort every sticker by foot y (then x), back to front; draw stickers after the base

start.note: bare counter, a few bottles, empty walls, one table, the owner behind the bar

full.note: bottles to the ceiling, photos, pennant, TV and neon, the cook, friends, the samba circle, Esme at a table and Mr Cat on a bar stool

door.note: the street door: back to location/outside-slots.json

esme_spot.note: Esme sits behind the middle table; Mr Cat on the last bar stool

baked: room shell, bar, back bar, stools, tables and chairs, kitchen doorway, fans, fixtures and people per state

slots.note: on the marble bar top, up to 12x14
on the window table (there from day one), up to 12x12
on the windowsill (Mr Cat's spot), up to 16x16
on the tiles under the chalkboard, up to 20x20
